rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details) and viewed order details. However, it performed order-changing writes (two modify_pending_order_items calls) without any visible explicit confirmation from the user, violating the policy. It also attempted a modification using a credit card payment_method_id, despite the user’s requirement to refund to a gift card, and there is no evidence the agent located or used the user’s gift card. Additionally, the conversation does not show the agent providing the requested arrival information or clearly stating the results of the cancellation/modification attempts. These issues collectively fail the pass bar.
